verdict.comment: Midnight Tango is a player but the one who appeals most is BLUE NGURU, who shaped well at Goodwood on debut and should improve

comments.alexsupreme: Ability at an ordinary level on debut a week ago; needs to step up a fair way to win this
comments.bluenguru: Shaped well when third to a well-regarded sort at Goodwood on debut; leading claims
comments.impalaka: Cost £52,000 at the breeze-ups and is out of a 7f-1m1f winner; market should guide
comments.indigosierra: Speedy pedigree and, although yard not renowned for debut winners, is one to note
comments.marchahead: Half-sister to a useful 5f-6f winner; market should be a good guide to prospects on debut
comments.midnighttango: From a stable in fine form and showed promise over this trip on debut at Newmarket; claims

races.raceComment: bluenguru is marginally preferred with a score of 21.4%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: This has an open look to it and can go to last year's winner TWO AULD PALS (nap), who is reunited with Oisin Orr and ran well last time

comments.dreamsadozen: Stays much further and may not want things to turn tactical dropping to this trip
comments.ebonymaw: Respectable efforts both runs this season and claims, despite dropping in distance
comments.haptics: Ex-French; slipped to a handy mark and last run may have come too quickly; interesting
comments.modelapproach: Dual hurdle winner for this yard but below best on Flat and over hurdles on last two runs
comments.sealegend: Isn't a regular winner but running well and worth another try over this sort of trip
comments.spanishhustle: Goes well here, stays 1m5f and ran well last time; high in the weights but can't rule out
comments.tokyobay: Maiden winner who gets headgear; hasn't progressed in handicaps and needs to raise game
comments.twoauldpals: Won this race from a 4lb higher mark last year; encouraging run last week and a player

races.raceComment: spanishhustle is marginally preferred with a score of 58.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over dreamsadozen. Placed in 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Good) looks ideal with 3 wins from 26 starts in similar conditions. Strong pace likely with multiple front-runners. Key attributes include optimal distance, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.belsito: Better than the bare facts at Carlisle a week ago; claims if things slot into place
comments.deputy: Back to winning ways in October but not seen since and ideally suited by plenty of cut
comments.dwindlingfunds: Well beaten on three of four runs but interesting Mulrennan rides in preference to Inanna
comments.glendown: Hasn't been at best on four of last five starts and has a bit to prove for now
comments.inanna: Knows how to win and bit better than bare form of last run; each-way prospect
comments.irisdancer: Course specialist who hasn't been at best on last five starts; dropped to a decent mark
comments.jannasjourney: Well beaten both outings in handicaps and has plenty to prove at present
comments.jumpthegun: Down in the weights and shaped well on latest start at Ayr; another to consider
comments.moyola: C&D winner nearly a year ago who is on a good mark and now gets first-time cheekpieces
comments.northfieldlake: Has shown ability but has yet to win; first run for yard but best watched after absence
comments.ramondiloria: Bit better than he was able to show at Catterick but winless here in 12 attempts
comments.sirgarfield: 3lb well following an improved effort at Carlisle; has few options from draw but claims
comments.taygar: Triple sprint winner; creditable third at Redcar last time and has each-way claims

verdict.comment: Mount Mogan looks solid to go well but TOUCHWOOD can improve for the return to this C&D and may be the answer.

comments.cillmocheallog: Won 7f maiden in Ireland last year; out of sorts on AW but down in weights and grade
comments.jacksonstreet: Out of sorts for new yard but well treated on best 7f AW form last summer; cheekpieces off
comments.mountmogan: In good form over C&D, winning twice and solid 3rd behind subsequent winners latest
comments.mymatemike: Two C&D wins in 2024; back on song when 7f Chelmsford winner in April; good shot
comments.okami: C&D winner off a way higher mark in 2023; minor form for new yard; return to 7f can suit
comments.southdakotasioux: Consistent over the winter, winning twice at 7f including back from break; can be involved
comments.teasea: Three narrow Tapeta wins at 7f and 1m around the New Year; acts on Polytrack; considered
comments.thorntonledalemax: Dead-heated for 7f AW handicap in August; now 2lb lower; rocked between extremes since
comments.thoughtfulgift: Enters the argument on best C&D form; fair 4th on turf latest; competitive back here
comments.touchwood: First C&D run since good win in 2023; O Murphy a rare booking for yard, 0-1 in last 5 yrs
comments.tronido: Won first 2 handicaps over 7f; back on latest winning mark; recent form not up to scratch

races.raceComment: teasea is marginally preferred with a score of 53.3%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions over touchwood. Won 3 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 4 wins from 10 starts in similar conditions. Key attributes include optimal distance, though returning from absence and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile and regressive form need consideration.

verdict.comment: It is hard to get away from MESAAFI who won a competitive apprentice race at Chelmsford in fine style on Sunday.

comments.bataldubai: Good chance on this winter's best but needs to leave some quiet runs behind him
comments.countotto: Conditions to suit & on lowly mark but this 10yo hasn't shone in two runs after an absence
comments.invinciblespeed: C&D win in April has been followed by one good and one bad run on turf; needs career-best
comments.ladywingalong: Flourished for this yard but up in class on the back of a rare modest effort last month
comments.maidinchelsea: Career-best when second at Bath latest; 2lb higher in a better race; cheekpieces now tried
comments.mcloven: On a dangerous mark but drawn widest and 6f has looked to stretch him in the past
comments.mesaafi: Impressive at Chelmsford on Sunday; unpenalised and holds strong claims
comments.rebelempire: C&D win in December was one of 3 successes over the winter; quiet on turf latest
comments.tygerbay: Third to Invincible Speed over C&D when last seen 65 days ago; eligible for weaker races

races.raceComment: mesaafi is marginally preferred with a score of 58.1%, holding clear edges in better ratings and stronger recent form over ladywingalong. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

comments.azleet: By Tasleet; half-sister to 7f 2yo (RPR 91) winner; market can guide on this debut
comments.caitling: 1,000gns yearling by Bangkok, who's already off the mark as a sire; tongue tied for debut
comments.flyingmacs: Green on her debut (5f); should do better and this extra furlong will likely help
comments.khuskhas: 15,000gns yearling who makes appeal on paper but is drawn widest for this introduction
comments.lexingtonexpress: Outpaced and beaten a fair way on her 5f debut (good to firm) 26 days ago; needs much more
comments.missayala: Half-sister to two AW winners; yard 0-8 with 2yos this year; best watched on debut
comments.missruby: Stable is 0-63 with its juveniles and this one was beaten a long way on her debut (5f)
comments.nifty: Good debut third (5f, good to firm); extra furlong a plus; sets the standard on AW debut
comments.rejjien: Not much to show for two runs; Rossa Ryan takes over but best watched on her AW debut
comments.sovereignbright: 15,000gns yearling; stamina in the family but sire should help for this trip; debut
comments.whoisalice: 9,500gns foal; dam won as a 2yo; market should be helpful ahead of this introduction

races.raceComment: nifty is marginally preferred with a score of 19.8%, holding clear edges in superior course form and more progressive over rejjien.
